82080.subject: A market for fees
82080.body:
View this post on the web at https://uniswap.substack.com/p/a-market-for-fees

Community news
Permissioned Pools for real estate: For the first time ever, a permissioned asset is live on the Uniswap AMM. Groma [ https://substack.com/redirect/93c08e0a-54bf-472a-94cb-b8d3db990394?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] brings real estate issuance and redemption directly to the protocol with the Permissioned Pools hook [ https://substack.com/redirect/f476638c-b326-41b1-8241-4fc2fbb2fbd5?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]. 
Uniswap v4 is now an aggregator: Last month, we shipped Aggregator Hooks. They’re v4 hooks that wrap outside liquidity sources. One swap reaches liquidity wherever it lives. More here. [ https://substack.com/redirect/1b5e31b3-3749-4111-b3ea-aaf40b05cbe0?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]
StablePair for stock tokens: Ondo Stocks are live on Robinhood Chain [ https://substack.com/redirect/e97376b3-2419-4d0e-82ca-2885abe5e087?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]. 15 Ondo tokenized stocks and ETFs can now bridge over from Ethereum and BNB Chain. StablePair pools pair them with Robinhood Stock Tokens. Swappers get better prices, and LPs keep more of the value. [ https://substack.com/redirect/117e7ca0-89f0-4cbd-ba9a-fc1e441b791c?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]
Where tokenized value trades: Uniswap is now the top venue for onchain tokenized stocks with more than $20B in trading volume to date [ https://substack.com/redirect/2eb54e34-7fa8-46c5-b602-5c0e4fc05e8b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ].
Markets that never close: Last week, 62% of tokenized stock volume on Uniswap traded after market hours [ https://substack.com/redirect/bc1058d2-500d-45e7-b621-f68d4f97f439?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]. Open all night, open forever 🦄
TJAR: permissionless infrastructure for onchain fee conversion
TJAR [ https://substack.com/redirect/69dfc4f2-dff3-4776-8f03-564fb2244ba6?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] is open source infrastructure built to streamline fees for teams. We break down how it works, what incentivizes searchers to run conversions, and how apps can set up TJAR for their own use cases.
Onchain systems often collect a large mix of tokens, ranging from blue chips to long tails and dust. Ultimately, they just want to convert them into a single token.
TJAR turns this conversion into an open market. Fees accumulate in a Token Jar, and searchers compete to exchange a fixed amount of the chosen token for assets in the jar.
The destination of the chosen token is configurable to support common patterns in DeFi, such as routing it to a treasury, burning it, or bridging it to an L1 recipient.

82067.subject: Donald Trump’s humiliation offers America an opportunity
82067.body:
The Economist Picks

Автор: The Economist


Автор: The Economist

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/donald-trumps-humiliation-offers-america-opportunity-the-economist-gqjie?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3Bevea5sCzRP2t0JPUy5k3Cg%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=2HQ7jF_guEeYw1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~mw4xtdgd~uj-null-null&eid=fz96fz-mw4xtdgd-uj
  
As a dad who took up surfing in middle age, I know a thing or two about looking foolish when struck by a large wave. My children, when small, would glide past and occasionally push me in. My wife took embarrassing photos of me toppling headfirst into the foam. But no Cornish breaker ever walloped me as hard—or as humiliatingly—as the blue wave that hit Donald Trump this week. Midterm voters delivered the biggest wipeout in half a century. Democrats have recaptured not only the House but also the Senate, and flipped at least five governors’ mansions. Every statewide office on the ballot in rocksolid-red Texas has turned blue. A Trump-picked Senate candidate in North Carolina lost by 20 points. As I write, it looks like a Democrat could win the US Senate race in Mississippi. That is not a misprint: Mississippi! Our cover package argues that Mr Trump’s humiliation presents America with an opportunity. Voters are fed up with the administration’s incompetence and shameless self-dealing. (The share of Americans who think corruption is widespread in their government now roughly matches that in Nigeria.) They are demanding something different. Politicians should let them have it.  Democrats face a tricky balancing act. On the one hand, they want to use their new power to expose and deter MAGA graft, as they should. On the other, they will need to work with the president to deal with the bread-and-butter problems that upset voters the most. Republicans face a brutal internal struggle, as some try to keep their party Trumpy and others seek to revive the notion that character matters in politics. Meanwhile, the president retains immense powers, especially over foreign policy. For the world, there are choppy waters ahead. If you want to hear more about a wild week in American politics, I’d encourage you to tune into The Insider. Zanny Minton Beddoes, our editor-in-chief, has handed the microphone to The Economist’s US politics crew. They will ask: is this the beginning of the end of the Trump era? You can watch now. 82014.subject: welcome to athletedata mcp
82014.body:
Hey Oleg,

Many thanks for signing up! We're Julian and Daniel and built the athletedata MCP server because we were tired of screenshotting our Garmin and WHOOP data into Claude every time we wanted to ask about our training.

Two steps to get going:

1. Connect your wearables and apps (Garmin, Strava, WHOOP, Apple Health, Google Calendar and many more)
2. Grab your API key and paste the MCP config into your favourite AI tool

Connect your apps: https://athletedata.health/dashboard/integrations

If anything's confusing or broken, just reply to this email - we personally read every reply.

Julian & Daniel

PS: You can also text your data. The trial includes our proactive coach on WhatsApp, Telegram or iMessage.
